veranderings.voor: Ons beskryf klimaat daarom per seisoen
veranderings.na: Daarom beskryf ons klimaat per seisoen
veranderings.rede: Putting 'daarom' first links the sentence more naturally to the one before it.

veranderings.voor: Wes-Kaap rondom Kaapstad en langs die weskus noord daarvan is dit andersom
veranderings.na: Wes-Kaap, rondom Kaapstad en langs die weskus noord daarvan, is dit andersom
veranderings.rede: Commas set off the place description so a Grade 5 reader can find where the long opening phrase ends and the main clause starts.

veranderings.voor: Die drie reënvalpatrone wys dus in watter soort gebied jou omgewing lê.
veranderings.na: Aan die drie reënvalpatrone sien jy dus in watter soort gebied jou omgewing lê.
veranderings.rede: A pattern does not 'wys' which area your surroundings lie in; 'aan ... sien jy' is the natural Afrikaans way to say you can tell it from them.

vlae.teks: langs die weskus noord daarvan is dit andersom
vlae.rede: The protected-word reasons say the qualifier 'die meeste van' keeps the west-coast claim true because the far northern west coast is very dry with a less clear pattern; this sentence names the west coast north of Cape Town without that qualifier. Not changed, since adding it would change content; for a person or the writer to judge.
